name: Parametric CAD Bench V3

scoring.official_submission_requires: one complete public 100-task Harbor job, one attempt per task, retries disabled

notes: The benchmark task suite is distributed through Harbor Hub rather than as a standalone Git checkout.
This repository does not include held-out reference geometry or verifier data.
The public pages reviewed here did not establish a task/data license; verify Harbor or Hugging Face terms before redistribution.
Demo runs over synthetic prompts or a partial task subset are engineering checks, not official benchmark scores.
